assumptions.emitter_point: the centre of each affected area, at emitter_height_m; the maps do not locate an emitter

link_model.boresight: the geocentric zenith (a zenith-pointing antenna; no attitude, no body or limb blockage)
link_model.replaces: receiver.gain_toward_ground_dbi (not used when the forecast is on)

assumptions.orbit: SGP4 from the element sets (open engine), TEME to ITRS; accuracy falls with element-set age
assumptions.propagation: free space at L1, no atmospheric or body losses, no terrain

forecast.activity: each area is active for a whole revolution with its activity probability, independently of the others; exact enumeration up to 10 uncertain areas in view per revolution, else a seeded Monte Carlo draw of 1024 samples
forecast.label: MODELLED per-revolution exposure forecast. The areas come from the maps and regions given (where interference was reported or is expected on the ground; no emitter is located), their activity probabilities are inputs, the interferer EIRP is assumed, and the receiver link margin is the stated model. A forecast of what the model gives for the orbit, not a prediction that any interferer will be on air.
forecast.outage_window: from the first step with a modelled margin under zero to the last one, plus reacquisition_s; runs closer than that are merged
forecast.revolution: a revolution starts at each ascending node (ITRS z crossing upward, interpolated between steps); the first and last revolutions of the span are partial

emitter_regions.attribution: Contains aircraft position data from adsb.lol, made available under the Open Database License (ODbL 1.0), https://opendatacommons.org/licenses/odbl/1-0/

label: MODELLED spaceborne GNSS receiver interference exposure. MEASURED: nothing on board; the inputs are published orbital elements (TLEs, propagated with SGP4) and interference maps built from aircraft or ship navigation-accuracy reports, which say where reports were degraded, not where an emitter was or how strong it was. MODELLED: the interferer EIRP (assumed, several values), the receive-antenna gains, free-space propagation, the anti-jam equation and, when the map period differs from the orbit period, the use of the map as a climatology. Not a statement about any receiver's measured performance.

span.time_mode_note: climatology: the areas' time windows do not overlap the span, so every area counts all the time; the result says what the orbit would see if the mapped areas were active, not what happened

test_scenarios.label: MODELLED: receiver test scenarios generated from this study; the J/S profiles follow from the assumed EIRP and the link model; the criteria are stated before any run. Not a result of any receiver test.

title: Per-revolution exposure forecast of four LEO GNSS receivers to the located Sep 2025 northern Baltic emitter-region sessions, with matching receiver test scenarios
